evidence: Matches the Private Broadcast label prior and directly affects transaction relay privacy over the network.
rationale: Fixes a privacy leak in transaction origin relay where periodic wallet rebroadcasts bypass private broadcast settings. When -privatebroadcast=1 is enabled, the node still rebroadcast unconfirmed transactions using the send-to-all path every 12 to 36 hours, leaking the node's IP address over regular peer connections.
